_note: Copy to data/applicant-profile.json and fill in. That file is gitignored — this repo is public, so your phone number and address must never be committed. Only fill in what you're comfortable having autofilled; leave anything else blank and you'll fill it by hand.

resume._note: Absolute path to your résumé PDF. The apply command will point you at the upload field — you attach the file yourself.

_neverAutofilled: Voluntary EEO self-identification (race, gender, veteran, disability) — these are yours to answer or skip
